method: Stop-gradient target, reconstruction, and equal-weight forward, paired-difference, and two-way outcome-matching losses; CUDA training with seed 20260927.
finding: The added matching objective reduced action ranking on the already inspected primary evaluation and on a reused click-button archive. It is not a successful fix.
limitations: The candidate was developed after inspecting prior failures, and the reused click-button archive is exploratory rather than fresh preregistered evidence.
Both candidates failed the earlier unseen-family acceptance gate; this comparison cannot establish cross-task transfer.
Features discard page text, task instruction, and hidden browser state. Visible-state equality is not a complete causal state.
No weights are shipped or loaded by Heliox. This is not real-desktop, safety, autonomy, or Jev-parity evidence.
